record.category: cloud iOS simulator and Android emulator
record.tier: Starter, with 60 simulator minutes included until 2027

free_tier.stated: Starter, Production and Enterprise plans include 60 simulator minutes a month until 2027; the Free plan lists Simulators as coming soon, and sessions start only on paid plans.
free_tier.notes: Starter is $19/month plus additional usage cost. Usage beyond the included minutes is $0.10 per simulator minute, billed per second.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a simulator session, not an object; one artifact can be up to about 5 GiB.

retention.stated: Job logs on the session page are available for 30 days after the session is created; session artifacts such as screenshots and recordings are kept until the session is deleted.
retention.notes: Artifact retention on the pricing table is 30 days; the security page says artifacts survive until the user deletes the session.

egress.terms: Without local egress, all traffic from the simulator exits from Expo infrastructure; with --egress local, device traffic exits from the user's computer and the egress client refuses local, private, link-local and multicast addresses.

record.interface_detail: Sessions start with the `eas simulator` CLI, the REST API or a browser live view; agents drive the device with agent-device, Argent or Appium commands, including MCP.
record.tooling: The EAS CLI and REST API start and stop sessions; Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, agent-device, Argent, Appium and Maestro drive the simulator.
record.chaining: A coding agent can install a build into an isolated cloud simulator, drive it, and attach a recording to a pull request without a local Mac.

limits.value: 60 simulator minutes a month included until 2027 on Starter, Production and Enterprise; then $0.10 per iOS Simulator or Android Emulator minute
115 minutes maximum session duration; 5 concurrencies on Starter up to 2 on macOS

record.limits_note: The session timer starts when the session is ready; the job running the session has a hard limit of the maximum duration plus five minutes. An unnamed session has no idle timeout until --max-idle-time-minutes is set. Sessions wait in the account's job concurrency queue.
record.binding_note: The 60 included minutes a month, then the $0.10 per-minute meter, bind before the 115-minute per-session cap for a single agent.

identity_cost.detail: Sessions require a paid Starter, Production or Enterprise plan. Whether a card is collected at signup is unverified: behind a sign-up.

record.reliability_note: A session that is not stopped runs until its maximum duration or idle limit; the REST API returns controller tokens only while the session is in-progress, and every session is isolated in its own VM.
record.confidence_note: Price, included minutes, session cap and retention are quoted from Expo's own pricing and documentation pages read on 2026-11-25; the signup gate is from the signup page.

record.notes: Expo Simulators is a hosted simulator/emulator service, not user-run software. The Free plan has no Simulators access (listed as coming soon); paid plans include 60 minutes a month until 2027 and then bill $0.10 a simulator minute. Session artifacts survive until the session is deleted; job logs are kept 30 days.
